newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-VILNIUS BOURSE LAUNCHES OFFIAL TRADING LIST.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-VILNIUS BOURSE LAUNCHES OFFIAL TRADING LIST.

text.p: Lithuania's national stock exchange started trading on its official list on Monday, the bourse said.
"Trade on the official list started today and we will begin calculating and announcing its index today," deputy chairman of the stock exchange, Dalia Jasiulaityte, told Reuters.
"Two companies, Medienos Plaushas and Rokishkis Cheese and two banks, Vilniaus and Hermis started to be traded on the official list of Vilnius bourse," Jasiulaityte added.
